Agile Robots introduces Agile ONE SN research humanoid with 71 degrees of freedom

Tactile hands, Jetson Thor and GR00T combine in a laboratory platform scheduled for early 2027.

Humanoids Daily ↗22 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A compact laboratory platform

Unveiled at GTC Berlin on October 21, Agile ONE SN is 1.4 meters tall, with 31 body degrees of freedom plus 20 in each Wuji hand, totaling 71. Payload is up to 3 kg per arm. Agile lists 43 kg while NVIDIA lists 40 kg, leaving the delivered specification worth checking.

Reducing integration before experiments

Jetson Thor, multi-view cameras and lidar accompany preconfigured GR00T 1.7 and whole-body control. Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab assets support demonstration capture, data generation, training, evaluation and physical testing. Researchers can integrate selected components with their existing stack.

Transfer and safety require validation

Agile intends skills and data to transfer to its larger industrial Agile ONE, but cross-body transfer needs task-specific validation. Availability is planned for early 2027. Halos integration remains exploratory, rather than proof of a fully implemented or certified safety platform.
